method_comment:
* Returns the MIME type that best matches the given first few bytes * of a document stream. Returns application/octet-stream if no better * match is found. *

* If multiple matches are found, the best (highest priority) matching * type is returned. If multiple matches are found with the same priority, * then all of these are returned. *

* The given byte array is expected to be at least {@link #getMinLength()} * long, or shorter only if the document stream itself is shorter. * * @param data first few bytes of a document stream * @return matching MIME type
